hypotheses.F0_pair_delta_is_sufficient: Pair-specific activation delta with a feature-average discovery gradient is directionally correct on at least 80% of finite patches.
hypotheses.F1_pair_gradient_is_sufficient: Pair-specific suffix gradient with a feature-average discovery activation delta is directionally correct on at least 80% of finite patches.
hypotheses.F2_joint_conditioning_is_necessary: Joint pair-delta and pair-gradient selection exceeds the better singly conditioned selector by at least 0.10 directional fraction.
hypotheses.F3_activation_delta_is_dominant_router_i: Pair-delta conditioning exceeds pair-gradient conditioning by at least 0.10 directional fraction.
hypotheses.F4_local_linearization_survives: For every selector, predicted first-order and finite shifts have the same sign on at least 80% of pairs.
hypotheses.F5_no_evaluation_outcomes_select_support: Supports use discovery means and/or held-out activations and derivatives, never finite intervention outcomes.
